findings.detail: Both reason and capture_text copy text without modifying it. Three names for the same logical line add bookkeeping and suggest transformations that never occur.
findings.fix: Match both regexes against text directly, remove the two assignments, and simplify the signature to check_output(text, file). Preserve the regexes, check order and exemption comments.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Naming: Remove redundant logical-line aliases.

strengths: Early returns make exemption and discard precedence clear.
Static samples keep individual guard cases easy to follow.
summary: Reviewed every path in the fixed committed scope and found one worthwhile simplification. No files or Git state were changed, and no project scripts ran, as required by the report-only override.
